name: Adaptive View and Pixel Sampling Scheduling
aliases: Adaptive Scheduling of View Budget and Pixel Sampling
definition: A scheduling mechanism that jointly adjusts the tile-wise pixel sampling rate ($r_{tile}$) and the number of sampled views ($K$) over training iterations to allocate more computation during difficult stages and reduce it as optimization converges.
summary: Adaptive View and Pixel Sampling Scheduling dynamically scales pixel density and view counts based on reconstruction error to optimize the trade-off between training speed and quality.
